page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 32 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and utilizing a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates solid performance across standard compute and memory operations. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 36,598.86 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13,329.0, both placing in the average tier. Its memory subsystem shows strong performance, with a PassMark memory score of 2,775.46, placing it in the top 25% tier. This is supported by a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 1,699.39 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the instance processes 31.4 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a text generation speed of 304.16 tokens per second for a small 135M LLM model, which is also in the top 25% performance tier.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network storage, which may introduce latency compared to local NVMe options. However, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong memory bandwidth, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, including database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference.
